<Activity x:Class="AnchorContextAware" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <ui:AnchorContextAware DesignAnchor="{x:Null}" DesignTarget="{x:Null}">
    <ui:AnchorContextAware.AnchorProvider>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor2Data">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor2Data" Name="ContextAnchor2Data" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
      </ActivityAction>
    </ui:AnchorContextAware.AnchorProvider>
    <ui:AnchorContextAware.TargetProvider>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor2Data">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="ui:Anchor2Data" Name="ContextAnchor2Data" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
      </ActivityAction>
    </ui:AnchorContextAware.TargetProvider>
  </ui:AnchorContextAware>
</Activity>
